q1.question: What exactly is an MVP?
q1.answer: A Minimum Viable Product is the simplest version of your software that already does the job — replacing the manual process or filling the gap your team can't hire for. It's about getting something real into your team's hands fast, without over-building before you know it's the right fix.

q2.question: How long does development take?
q2.answer: Typically 4-8 weeks, depending on scope. We work in weekly sprints with regular demos so you can see progress and give feedback.

q3.question: What happens after launch?
q3.answer: You receive complete documentation and access to all code. We offer optional maintenance contracts, but you're not tied to us - everything belongs to you.

q4.question: What technologies do you use?
q4.answer: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL or Supabase. Modern, proven tools with a large community and good documentation.

invoice-distribution.description: A company needed automated invoice generation based on transaction types and timing, with proper filing and delivery. items.q: What is an Operations Audit (process automation audit)?
items.a: An Operations Audit is a paid process automation audit for growing companies. A senior operator-engineer maps your team's real workflows and manual work, quantifies where you lose hours and revenue, and shows you exactly what to automate first — handing you a build-ready roadmap, the spec your next automation or product is built from. It costs €2,500 and takes 5 business days.

You get a 12–20 page build-ready roadmap: current-state workflow maps, a quantified time and revenue leak table, a prioritized 90-day roadmap, and a build-ready spec of your single highest-impact quick win — delivered on a 45-minute walkthrough call. It's a plan you could hand to any team, whether or not you build with us.
The Operations Audit is a fixed €2,500. If you go on to a build with us within 60 days, 50% of the Audit fee is credited toward it — so half of it effectively comes back.

items.q: How long does it take, and what if you're late?
items.a: Five business days from our discovery call. Your roadmap arrives in 5 business days or it's free — that's the guarantee. We only need about 90 minutes of your time: one discovery call plus read-only access to two or three systems.

prospectify.title: How Prospectify automated its manual outbound into one system
prospectify.subtitle: Prospectify runs outbound for 20+ clients with a team of 7+ SDRs. Their growth was stalling, and the reason wasn't leads or talent — too much of the work was still done by hand. We rebuilt the whole operation into one automated system.
prospectify.forWhom: For: B2B SaaS sales teams running prospecting on a stack of disconnected tools
prospectify.deliveryModel: Delivered by Z-Flow + a curated specialist team — working MVP in 8 weeks, full product in 12.

challenge.intro: Prospectify already had momentum: a growing client list and campaigns running across email and LinkedIn. But the work sat on top of disconnected tools and spreadsheets. Leads were deduplicated, scored, and routed by hand. Every handoff was a chance to lose something. It all worked, but only because people kept watching it — and that gets expensive as you grow, putting a hard limit on how many clients one team can carry.
painPoints: Leads deduplicated, scored, and routed entirely by hand
A plan to pass 150,000 leads and 20+ clients without adding headcount
Outreach scattered across tools with no single source of truth
Every handoff a chance to lose something — only working because people kept watching it
challenge.quote: All of our prospecting processes were spread across different tools and systems. Things worked, but there was a lot of manual work and room for mistakes. Working with Z-Flow brought everything together into one streamlined process.

solution.intro: Hiring wasn't the fix — more people managing more tools would only mean more manual work and more mistakes. So instead of patching the setup again, Prospectify decided to automate it properly and rebuild on something that could actually scale. We put the whole operation in one place.
solution.approach: A 14-workflow n8n engine with Supabase as the single source of truth connects Smartlead and HeyReach for outbound and Airtable for the team's daily work. The parts that book meetings now run on their own: each campaign gets its own ICP scoring, every prospect's website is scraped and matched against that campaign's ideal customer, and replies are sorted automatically so nothing sits unread or gets sent to the wrong place. The piece founders mention most is a custom MCP server — they ask their entire operation questions in plain English through Claude and get a straight answer. No dashboards, no waiting on a report.

metrics.label: Manual work eliminated
metrics.improvement: 580 hours of repeated manual work, gone

metrics.label: Operating model
metrics.improvement: Same team, more clients, far less manual work

takeaways: Hiring wasn't the fix — automating the manual work was what unlocked scale
A 14-workflow n8n engine on Supabase put the whole operation in one place
A custom MCP server lets the team query their entire operation in plain English
results.quote: The biggest win has been reliability. A lot of processes now run on autopilot, which has significantly reduced errors and freed up time for our team to focus on higher-value activities.

layovr.title: Helping layover travelers make the most of their time
layovr.subtitle: Travel platform helping passengers make the most of airport layovers with real-time data.

challenge.intro: Travelers with layovers often waste hours at airports with no idea what's available around their gate. Flight information is scattered across different apps, and there's no way to connect with other travelers or discover nearby services.
painPoints: No centralized platform for layover planning
Flight data scattered across multiple apps and screens
No way to discover gate-specific F&B and services
Travelers feel isolated during long layovers

solution.intro: We built Layovr — a platform that combines real-time flight tracking with location-based airport services and a gate community feature. Travelers can look up flights, discover nearby offers, and connect with other passengers in their gate area.
solution.approach: Next.js frontend with Supabase for user data and real-time features. AviationStack API provides live flight data. Location-based services use geofencing to show relevant gate-area offerings. The community feature uses Supabase Realtime for instant messaging.

takeaways: Aviation APIs require robust error handling — flight data can be delayed or inconsistent
Location-based features need careful UX to avoid overwhelming users with options
Supabase Realtime worked excellently for the community chat feature

ai-video-generation.title: 50+ marketing videos a week, generated by AI
ai-video-generation.subtitle: Automated pipeline generating 50+ marketing videos weekly from single images.

challenge.intro: A marketing agency was spending enormous time creating video content variations from static images. Each video required manual editing, caption generation in multiple languages, and export to various formats for distribution.
painPoints: Manual video creation taking hours per piece
Multi-language captions required manual translation
No scalable way to produce content variations
Distribution data scattered across spreadsheets

solution.intro: We built an end-to-end video generation pipeline using n8n, OpenAI, and Ideogram. The system takes a single image input through an Airtable interface, generates multiple video variations, adds multi-language captions, and exports structured data for distribution.
solution.approach: The n8n workflow orchestrates the full pipeline: image input from Airtable triggers OpenAI for content generation, Ideogram for visual variations, and automated caption generation in multiple languages. Results are exported to Google Sheets for the distribution team.

takeaways: Airtable as a user interface dramatically reduces training time for non-technical team members
AI-generated content quality improved significantly with structured prompting
The pipeline scales linearly — doubling output requires zero additional labor

ai-voice-agent.title: 85% of support inquiries handled without a human
ai-voice-agent.subtitle: 24/7 AI phone agent handling 85% of customer inquiries without human intervention.

challenge.intro: A construction company received constant customer calls about project status, delivery schedules, and basic inquiries. Their small support team couldn't handle the volume, especially outside business hours, leading to missed calls and frustrated customers.
painPoints: Support team overwhelmed with repetitive status inquiries
No after-hours availability for customer calls
Project status information scattered across multiple systems
Missed calls leading to customer dissatisfaction

solution.intro: We built an AI voice agent using 11Labs voice technology connected to the company's project data via n8n workflows. The agent answers calls naturally, accesses real-time project data from Airtable, and logs all interactions automatically for the team to review.
solution.approach: 11Labs provides natural voice synthesis. n8n workflows handle the intelligence layer — routing calls, querying Airtable for project data, and logging interactions. OpenRouter powers the conversational AI that understands context and provides accurate answers.

takeaways: Voice AI quality is now good enough for professional customer-facing applications
Structured project data in Airtable was key — the AI is only as good as its data access
Automatic interaction logging gives the team visibility without manual work

lead-generation-pipeline.title: A lead pipeline that runs itself
lead-generation-pipeline.subtitle: 14 interconnected workflows creating a single source of truth for all lead data.

challenge.intro: A B2B sales team was managing leads across multiple disconnected platforms — Smartlead, Heyreach, Airtable, and a Supabase database. Data was constantly out of sync, leads fell through the cracks, and response times suffered.
painPoints: Lead data fragmented across 4+ platforms
No single source of truth for pipeline status
Manual data entry causing duplicates and errors
Slow response times due to missed notifications

solution.intro: We designed and built 14 interconnected n8n workflows that orchestrate the entire lead lifecycle across all platforms. A single source of truth database in Supabase handles deduplication, status tracking, and sync across all tools.
solution.approach: Each workflow handles a specific sync scenario — inbound leads from Smartlead, LinkedIn responses from Heyreach, manual additions from Airtable. Edge cases like duplicate detection, status conflicts, and platform-specific data formats are all handled automatically.

takeaways: Process mapping before automation was critical — without understanding all data flows first, the workflows would have missed edge cases
n8n's ability to handle complex branching logic made it ideal for multi-platform orchestration
A single source of truth database eliminates the root cause of data sync issues

automated-invoicing.title: 95% fewer invoice errors, fully automated
automated-invoicing.subtitle: Complete invoicing lifecycle automated with 95% error reduction and full audit trail.

challenge.intro: A client with complex invoicing requirements was handling everything manually — creating invoices, tracking edits, managing cancellations, and reissuing corrected versions. The process was error-prone and lacked any audit trail for compliance.
painPoints: Manual invoice creation consuming hours daily
High error rate in invoice amounts and details
No audit trail for compliance requirements
Cancellation and reissue process was confusing and slow

solution.intro: We built an n8n-powered invoicing system with an intuitive Airtable interface. The system handles the complete lifecycle — creating, editing, canceling, and reissuing invoices — with full audit trails at every step.
solution.approach: Airtable serves as the user interface where the team manages invoice data. n8n workflows handle the business logic: validation, PDF generation, status tracking, and audit logging. Every action is timestamped and traceable.

takeaways: Airtable as a front-end dramatically reduces training time compared to custom UI
Full audit trails should be built in from day one, not retrofitted
The one-click interface increased team adoption to near 100%

stripe-refund-automation.title: Refunds processed in 30 seconds, not 15 minutes
stripe-refund-automation.subtitle: One-click refund system processing 200+ daily refunds with zero manual errors.

challenge.intro: An e-commerce business was processing refunds manually through multiple systems — checking orders in one tool, processing refunds in Stripe, updating accounting in Lexoffice, and tracking everything in spreadsheets. Each refund took 15+ minutes.
painPoints: Each refund required touching 4 separate systems
15+ minutes per refund, 200+ refunds daily
Manual errors causing accounting discrepancies
Team burned out on repetitive administrative work

solution.intro: We built a one-click refund system using Make.com. A simple checkbox in Airtable triggers the entire refund workflow — processing through Stripe, updating Lexoffice, and logging the transaction.
solution.approach: Make.com orchestrates the workflow: checkbox trigger in Airtable → Stripe refund API → Lexoffice accounting update → confirmation notification. Error handling catches failed refunds and alerts the team.

takeaways: The simplest possible UI (a checkbox) drove the highest adoption rate
Connecting accounting software early in the workflow prevents reconciliation issues
Error handling is critical when automating financial transactions

car-supplier-integration.title: 500+ car listings synced every day, automatically
car-supplier-integration.subtitle: Unified pipeline syncing 500+ vehicle listings daily from 3 supplier APIs.

challenge.intro: A car reseller needed to aggregate vehicle data from multiple suppliers, each with different API formats and update schedules. Listings had to be enriched with market data and synced to their sales platform in near real-time.
painPoints: 3 supplier APIs with incompatible data formats
Manual data entry causing listing errors
No automated enrichment with market pricing data
Sales platform inventory always out of date

solution.intro: We built a comprehensive Make.com automation that normalizes data from all three supplier APIs, enriches listings with market data, and syncs everything to the Bubble.io sales platform.
solution.approach: Make.com handles the orchestration: scheduled pulls from each supplier API, data normalization into a common format in Airtable, enrichment with third-party market data, and upload to Bubble.io via API. A PostgreSQL database serves as the canonical data store.

takeaways: Data normalization is the hardest part — each supplier has quirks that need handling
A canonical data store prevents sync conflicts when multiple sources update the same listing
Scheduled automation with error alerting is more reliable than real-time triggers for supplier data

invoice-distribution.title: Every invoice filed automatically, no manual sorting
invoice-distribution.subtitle: Automated invoice generation with smart filing and instant email delivery.

challenge.intro: A company needed invoices generated automatically based on transaction types, filed in the correct Google Drive folders, and emailed to the right recipients — all based on complex business rules that varied by client and transaction type.
painPoints: Manual invoice creation from transaction data
Complex filing rules for different transaction types
Emails sent manually with attachments
Frequent misfiling and missed deliveries

solution.intro: We built a Make.com workflow that handles the full invoice lifecycle: generation from templates, smart filing based on business rules, and automated email delivery with proper attachments.
solution.approach: Make.com pulls transaction data from Airtable, generates invoices via Google Docs API with correct formatting, saves to dynamically determined Google Drive folders, and emails completed invoices to clients. Bubble.io records are updated with delivery status.

takeaways: Business rule complexity is often underestimated — mapping all scenarios before building is essential
Google Drive folder naming conventions matter more than you think for long-term organization
Automated delivery confirmation gives the team confidence the system is working

financial-folders.title: Financial folders that organize themselves
financial-folders.subtitle: Dynamic folder structures for international accounting with zero manual filing.

challenge.intro: A finance department managing international operations needed dynamic folder structures in Google Drive that match accounting requirements for different jurisdictions. Creating and maintaining these structures manually was time-consuming and error-prone.
painPoints: Manual folder creation for each accounting period
Different structures required per jurisdiction
Invoices frequently filed in wrong locations
No standardization across the organization

solution.intro: We created a Make.com automation that generates folder hierarchies based on accounting rules and jurisdiction requirements, automatically distributing invoices to correct locations.
solution.approach: Make.com workflows create folder structures based on configurable rules — accounting period, jurisdiction, document type. When new invoices arrive, the system determines the correct folder path and files them automatically.

takeaways: Accounting folder structures seem simple but have surprising edge cases across jurisdictions
Automating the organizational layer saves more time than automating individual file operations
Standardized naming conventions should be established before building any automation

volunteer-management.title: Volunteer onboarding 80% faster
volunteer-management.subtitle: Internal platform reducing volunteer onboarding time by 80% with role-based access.

challenge.intro: A non-profit volunteering agency needed to manage applicants through a complex multi-step process including background checks, references, and parental approvals. The existing paper-based system couldn't scale and lacked proper access controls.
painPoints: Paper-based application process taking weeks
No role-based access control for sensitive data
Background check workflow entirely manual
No visibility into pipeline status for management

solution.intro: We built a WeWeb application with Xano backend featuring role-based permissions, automated workflow stages, and a dashboard giving management full pipeline visibility.
solution.approach: WeWeb provides the frontend with role-based views — applicants see their status, reviewers see pending applications, admins see the full pipeline. Xano handles authentication, data storage, and business logic. n8n automates notifications and status transitions.

takeaways: WeWeb + Xano is an excellent combination for internal tools that need role-based access
Non-profit organizations have surprisingly complex compliance requirements
Automating status notifications reduced follow-up inquiries by over 60%

hero.title: Company Brain
hero.subtitle: Company Brain connects to your team's tools — code, chat, docs, tickets — and turns scattered activity into a clear picture of how work flows, where collaboration thrives, and where knowledge is at risk. Privacy-first, metadata-only by default. It's also the kind of AI system we build for clients — and one tuned to your stack starts with an Operations Audit.

problem.title: Your company runs on dozens of tools. But can you see the full picture?
problem.subtitle: Your team uses dozens of tools every day. But no single place tells you how work actually flows, where collaboration thrives, and where the gaps are.

card1.title: Blind spots in how work happens
card1.description: You only see what happens in meetings and standup reports. The rest — code reviews, documentation, async collaboration — is invisible.

card2.title: Decisions based on gut feeling
card2.description: Organizational decisions rely on anecdotes and assumptions. Objective data across all work tools doesn't exist.

card3.title: No cross-tool visibility
card3.description: GitHub shows code. Jira shows tickets. Slack shows messages. Nobody connects the dots across tools to show the full picture.

card4.title: Knowledge silos
card4.description: You can't tell where knowledge lives, how it flows, or where it's concentrated — until someone leaves and the team scrambles.

howItWorks.title: From connected tools to actionable insights in 48 hours

step1.title: Connect
step1.description: We map your company's toolchain and build custom connectors — whether that's GitHub, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, or anything else. Most integrations go live within 48 hours.

step2.title: Analyze
step2.description: AI runs daily analysis. All activity is normalized into a unified event stream and aggregated at the team level — giving you a clear picture of organizational patterns across tools.

step3.title: Understand
step3.description: Get team-level insights across 5 dimensions, with daily trends, identified strengths, collaboration patterns, knowledge distribution, and areas for organizational improvement.

dimensions.title: Organizational health, measured across five lenses
dimensions.subtitle: Your team's activity is analyzed across five dimensions with trend indicators. Insights are evidence-based — backed by real activity data, not opinions.

output.title: Output
output.description: Team delivery patterns — PRs merged, issues closed, documents written, releases shipped. Understand throughput trends across your organization.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Cross-team dynamics — code review activity, cross-functional participation, meeting patterns, and mentoring signals across the organization.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Knowledge distribution — documentation contributions, wiki activity, how-to guides, and where expertise concentration risks exist.

growth.title: Growth
growth.description: Organizational learning — adoption of new domains, scope expansion patterns, and how the team is evolving its capabilities.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.description: Initiative patterns — who drives discussions, unblocks others, and coordinates across teams. Understand where leadership behavior emerges.

knowledgeSources.title: Your company's knowledge, captured and searchable
knowledgeSources.subtitle: Company Brain can go beyond metadata. With your consent, it ingests real content from your tools — making your team's collective knowledge searchable and actionable.

slack.title: Slack Public Channels
slack.description: Decisions, context, and discussions from public channels — captured so institutional knowledge doesn't vanish in the scroll.

meetings.title: Meeting Transcripts
meetings.description: With recording consent, meeting notes and transcripts become searchable knowledge — decisions, action items, and context preserved.

docs.title: Internal Documentation
docs.description: Confluence pages, Notion docs, Google Docs — your team's written knowledge indexed and queryable via AI.

tickets.title: Project Context
tickets.description: Jira and Linear tickets, GitHub issues and PRs — the reasoning behind decisions captured alongside the outcomes.

knowledgeSources.consent: All content ingestion requires explicit organizational consent. You choose what gets indexed.

privacy.title: Metadata only. We see that work happened — not what was said.
privacy.subtitle: Company Brain is built on a strict metadata-only architecture. No message content, no document text, no code — just activity signals.

point1.title: Metadata only
point1.description: We track that a PR was merged, not what code was written. That a Slack message was sent, not what it said.

point2.title: Isolated database
point2.description: Each company gets its own dedicated database. Your data never touches another company's infrastructure.

point3.title: GDPR compliant
point3.description: European hosting available. Built with German data protection standards in mind from day one.

point4.title: Not SaaS
point4.description: Company Brain is deployed specifically for your organization. No shared infrastructure, no multi-tenant risks.

compliance.title: EU AI Act & GDPR Compliant
compliance.subtitle: Company Brain is built to meet EU AI Act and GDPR requirements from day one — not as an afterthought.

transparency.title: AI Transparency
transparency.description: Users always know they're interacting with AI. Every response is labeled, models are disclosed, and AI-generated content is machine-readable.

dataProtection.title: GDPR by Design
dataProtection.description: Consent management, right-to-deletion, data retention policies, and full audit trails built into the platform.

humanOversight.title: Human Oversight
humanOversight.description: AI assists — it never makes autonomous decisions. No individual evaluation or ranking, no surveillance, no high-risk use cases.

audience.title: Built for leaders who want data, not surveillance

engineering.title: Engineering Managers
engineering.description: Get objective data on team dynamics instead of relying on gut feeling and standup reports.

cto.title: CTOs & VPs of Engineering
cto.description: Cross-team visibility without micromanaging. Understand work patterns across your entire engineering organization.

hr.title: HR & People Ops
hr.description: Transition from subjective reviews to data-informed organizational insights. Fair, evidence-based team analytics.

coo.title: COOs of Remote Teams
coo.description: Understand how distributed teams collaborate across time zones and tools without invasive monitoring.

audience.teamSize: Companies with 20-200+ employees across multiple tools

deployment.title: Custom-deployed for your organization
deployment.subtitle: Company Brain is not SaaS. Z-Flow deploys and configures it specifically for your company's tool stack and team structure.

point1.title: Custom setup
point1.description: Z-Flow engineers configure Company Brain for your specific tools, teams, and organizational structure.

point2.title: Isolated infrastructure
point2.description: Your Company Brain runs on dedicated infrastructure. Your data stays in your environment.

point3.title: Ongoing support
point3.description: We handle maintenance, updates, and adding new integrations as your tool stack evolves.

q1.question: Does Company Brain read our Slack messages or code?
q1.answer: By default, Company Brain processes metadata only — that a message was sent, not what it said. However, with your explicit consent, it can ingest content from public Slack channels, meeting transcripts, and documentation to build a searchable knowledge base. You always control what gets indexed.

q2.question: Who can see the insights?
q2.answer: This is fully configurable. You decide who sees what — team-level dashboards can be visible to managers only, to specific teams, or across the whole organization.

q3.question: How quickly will we see insights?
q3.answer: First analysis runs within 24-48 hours after connecting your tools. The AI needs a few days of data to establish baseline patterns, but you'll see initial insights immediately.

q4.question: What if we use tools that aren't listed?
q4.answer: We can build custom integrations for additional tools. Company Brain's architecture is designed to ingest activity data from any tool with an API or webhook support.

q5.question: How is this different from Jellyfish or LinearB?
q5.answer: Three key differences: (1) Company Brain is deployed per-company, not SaaS — your data stays isolated. (2) We analyze across 5 dimensions including Knowledge and Leadership, not just DORA/engineering metrics. (3) Metadata-only architecture means privacy is built into the system, not just a policy.
